subject.title: Carry provider-authoritative agent identity for adopted catalog sessions

question: Should provider-authoritative `agentId` be introduced as a staged additive plugin contract now, made immediately mandatory, or deferred until non-default-agent adoption is implemented?
rationale: The desired ownership invariant is clear, but requiredness and fallback behavior affect a potentially shipped plugin API; repository policy requires maintainer intent for that compatibility choice.

options.title: Stage the additive contract
options.body: Add optional `agentId`, populate every bundled adapter, prefer it in core with focused compatibility tests, and define when the legacy fallback is removed.

options.title: Require identity immediately
options.body: Make `agentId` mandatory only with evidence that no supported external providers break or with an explicit plugin API migration and deprecation plan.

options.title: Defer the contract
options.body: Keep the issue open as the prerequisite for any future non-default-agent adoption and implement both changes together.

recommendation.title: Stage the additive contract
recommendation.body: Add optional `agentId`, populate every bundled adapter, prefer it in core with focused compatibility tests, and define when the legacy fallback is removed.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant provider, gateway adoption, and upstream-link behavior appears to originate in their two immediately preceding merged changes.
